capabilities.title: Three-OS CI pipeline from the first commit
capabilities.requirement: every push and PR runs build, format, lint (warnings fatal), the tokio-free check of the sync crates, the dependency policy (licences, C-crate, tokio and banned-crate rules, advisories, sources), workflow linting and tests, natively on Windows, macOS and Linux; all actions are SHA-pinned under least-privilege permissions; a weekly scheduled advisory check runs without code changes; the perf gates run in their own job; tools the gates need are checked present first and fail loudly if missing; test homes survive until every gate has read them; and nothing from a test home is uploaded unless the secret scan passed.
capabilities.observed_gap: no workspace, no `Cargo.toml`, no `.github/workflows/`; nothing builds or runs in CI (H:91-94). Two masters disagree on CI mechanics: the perf gates' job (tests: own job; obs: inside E2E), `jq`/`rg` availability, where test homes live and whether they survive until the gates, and which artifacts upload after the secret scan (XF F1, F2, B1, B4, B7, Z8).

verification.acceptance: Every push and pull request produces a pipeline run on Windows, macOS and Linux covering build, formatting, fatal lint, the tokio-free check of the sync crates, the dependency policy, workflow linting and tests; a weekly scheduled advisory run executes without code changes; the perf gates run in a job of their own; a missing gate tool fails the run loudly; test homes survive until every gate has read them; and nothing from a test home is uploaded from a run whose secret scan failed.

capabilities.title: Mutation gate per chunk from chunk 1

An unreachable base (the all-zero sha included) exits 1 with `reason:"base-missing"` and leaves no `target/agent-run/chunk.diff`. This chunk's own run on base `13b7ee32e6227d1cb6cecc96fbe412fe34a4e0e6` exits 0 with the `mutants` suite `survived: 0`, over a diff that contains the panic hook and the role logger, so observability code is mutated like product code. Each guard test in this plan (the base-missing guard and the mutants exit-code guard) kills its own remove-the-guard mutant within that run.

2026-09-24 (2026-09-24-three-os-ci-headless-harness-skeleton, wrap P7): CI witness. The first push (b0236ca, run 35971295434) was red on all jobs: the test job lacked cargo-mutants, `ProcessId::kill` counted a Unix zombie as killed, and a viola-e2e-only diff failed the cargo-mutants baseline. The fix commit 966b7aa (run 35972580463) concluded success on test (windows-2025, macos-latest, ubuntu-latest) and mutants (base = github.event.before = b0236ca).

By construction, three parts, all required:

(a) The release build contains no test-only binary.
- `bash scripts/release-check.sh --probe` prints `release-check probes: 3/3 refused, control clean`. It refuses records naming `viola-harness` or `viola-fake-agent`, and refuses an empty stream.

verification.acceptance: One page shows the budget header with age, gate, tape and skipped state, a wrapped rack and an unwrapped read-only rack of fixed-field strips in stable name order as native tables, a cocked strip for a pending dialog, transfer markers for links, and a tape that never announces arrivals with a readback box on every send that changes only on the logged outcome; upstream text renders as text; no horizontal scroll at the supported widths on the Linux font fallback; no spinner or loading text; out-of-view attention comes through the title and polite announcements; focus never moves or is lost on live updates or trimming; the CLI board and the page agree cell for cell.

capabilities.title: Automated accessibility verdict on every page state
capabilities.requirement: every web-spa state (steady, narrow, empty, expanded line, scrolled up, trimmed, cocked, refused, unconfirmable, human wheel, degraded, access) passes the a11y configuration with zero violations and zero contrast-incomplete items; the keyboard sequence equals the oracle with no trap and focus never obscured by the sticky header; only the defined messages are announced, each once; every applicable success criterion has at least one passing tagged test; lint errors in the page templates fail the build; violation rows land only in test artifacts, scrubbed, with no CSP or Trusted Types violation during any check.
capabilities.observed_gap: a11y binds axe inside the tests' Playwright driver with a fixed rule configuration, plus keyboard, aria-tree, screen-reader-proxy, html-validation and lint checks, all reduced to violation rows (AY §3); none exists.

verification.acceptance: Every web page state (steady, narrow, empty, expanded line, scrolled up, trimmed, cocked, refused, unconfirmable, human wheel, degraded, access) passes the accessibility configuration with zero violations and zero contrast-incomplete items; the keyboard sequence equals the oracle with no trap and focus is never obscured by the sticky header; only the defined messages are announced, each once; every applicable success criterion has at least one passing tagged test; lint errors in the page templates fail the build; violation rows land only in scrubbed test artifacts, with no content-security or trusted-types violation during any check.

capabilities.title: Token-pair contrast, forced colours and reduced motion hold
capabilities.requirement: every design token pair used for text meets 4.5:1 and every non-text state pair (rules, strike, cock band, focus ring) meets 3:1 on the rendered Linux fallback; no failing ink is ever placed on the holder surface; under forced colours every state border, strike and band stays distinguishable, and under reduced motion both motions drop to zero while the cocked position and band remain.
capabilities.observed_gap: design fixes eight colours and computed contrast by hand, with three inks failing AA on the holder surface (DS Color Palette contrast rules); a11y binds a token-pair checker and forced-colours/reduced-motion checks (AY §6).

verification.acceptance: Every design token pair used for text meets 4.5:1 and every non-text state pair meets 3:1 on the rendered Linux fallback; no failing ink is ever placed on the holder surface; under forced colours every state border, strike and band stays distinguishable; under reduced motion both motions drop to zero while the cocked position and band remain.

capabilities.title: The 401 access strip after a UI restart
capabilities.requirement: a page whose cookie no longer matches the running `viola ui` shows the access strip in place of the stopped tape, announces it once, tells the user in plain words how to recover (the launch line, the launch file, or a restart), and never shows or echoes the token, URL, `?t=` or file path.
capabilities.observed_gap: after `viola ui` restarts, the open page's SSE gets 401 but design shows `TAPE stopped · not answering` instead of the access strip (XF X9); a11y requires the access strip, announced, with a plain recovery line (AY P5; a11y overseer direction 4).

verification.acceptance: After viola ui restarts, a page whose cookie no longer matches shows the access strip in place of the stopped tape, announces it once, tells the user in plain words how to recover, and never shows or echoes the token, URL, token query or file path.

capabilities.title: Linux and macOS reach parity with Windows
capabilities.requirement: on Linux and macOS the same end-to-end suite passes against the fake agent (openpty, per-user socket directory, file modes, peer and server checks, macOS gap recorded), Windows remains the live-supported target, and one live `viola run` on Linux confirms the fake agent's Unix behaviour before the Unix-specific chunk lands.
capabilities.observed_gap: every live measurement is Windows-only (B §5 O5); the Unix endpoint location, modes and peer checks differ per OS; a Linux live run is suggested before the first Unix chunk (H:180-181).

verification.acceptance: On Linux and macOS the same end-to-end suite passes against the fake agent, covering the PTY, the per-user socket directory, file modes, and peer and server checks, with the macOS gap recorded; Windows remains the live-supported target; one live viola run on Linux confirms the fake agent's Unix behaviour.
